response.rationale: The item was delivered 35 days ago and is not final sale, so under RET-008 it falls outside the 30-day return window and returns are not accepted. Although the fact record has defective=True (which would trigger RET-020, a higher-priority eligible rule), the customer explicitly states nothing is broken and there is no damage — the issue is a self-reported sizing mistake, not a defect. The condition for RET-020 is not actually true on the real facts, so it does not apply. No goodwill grant or fraud hold is present.
